_comment: Aspirational gate for the multilingual agentic dataset v2. Describes what a production multilingual injection guard should clear: a global recall bar, per-language floors, and a recall parity cap so no language is left behind. Shipped guards fail this today — the point is the gap. Only en/es/fa are authored (and unreviewed), so required_languages lists just those; extend it as languages are released. The gate loader ignores this _comment key.
